# Undersky

> Undersky is a private astrology app for iPhone and Android. It computes your birth chart, your daily horoscope, an overview of your year, and relationship (synastry) readings. There is no account, no tracking, and no advertising, and your information stays on your phone and is never collected. There are no subscriptions. It is written in 26 languages. Published by Pacefyx, Inc. Launching August 2026.

## Pages
- [Home](https://undersky.app/): what Undersky is and why it is private by design
- [FAQ](https://undersky.app/faq.html): privacy, price, accuracy, languages, and how readings are made
- [Support](https://undersky.app/support.html): help and contact
- [Privacy policy](https://undersky.app/privacy.html): the Data Not Collected policy
- [Terms of use](https://undersky.app/terms.html): terms and disclaimers
- [Sources and credits](https://undersky.app/credits.html): star data, astronomical methods, and typefaces

## Key facts
- Private by design: no account, no tracking, no ads, and no developer server. Birth details, charts, and readings stay on the user's phone and are never collected. The App Store privacy label reads Data Not Collected.
- Free: the daily horoscope, the natal chart and its reading, and the overview of the year are all free, every day.
- Optional purchases, no subscriptions: relationship readings are a small one-time purchase that stays yours and grows as the relationship does; precise to-the-minute forecasts can be bought for planning.
- Accurate astronomy: positions are computed with precise astronomy and checked against independent sources. Eclipses, retrogrades, and returns come from the real sky. The exact degrees are always available in Explore.
- Relationship-aware and family-safe: every relationship has its own lens, and readings about children stay developmental, enforced by the app itself.
- Works offline. Readings are composed on the device from the reader's own chart and a library of writing prepared and reviewed in advance.
- Languages: 26, transcreated rather than machine-translated, with astrology terms and cultural context adapted for each.
- Purpose: reflection and entertainment, not fixed prediction and not verdicts about people.
